latestVersion.changelog:
Video Editing with Claude Code — initial release

- Launches a developer-focused tool for automating video edits via Claude-generated scripts.
- Supports raw video upload (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and code-based editing instructions.
- Handles authentication (NEMO_TOKEN or free starter token from API), session management, and cloud GPU rendering.
- Offers seamless workflows for video trimming, adding overlays, exporting to 1080p MP4, and more — no manual timeline work required.
- Includes robust error handling, session persistence, and credit management for a smooth user experience.
- Provides clear guidance and tips for getting the best results from AI-assisted video editing.
